svg.title: launching-free-tier-startups
svg.desc: A coding-agent skill for choosing a startup stack and checking usage meters before deployment. The skill's five-layer reference is Cloudflare Workers for frontend, Convex Free for backend and database, Better Auth for authentication, PostHog for analytics, and Cloudflare R2 Standard for files. This is a reference specimen, not a screenshot. Free allowances do not guarantee a zero-cost bill.

g.aria-label: check the meters before you deploy.
